Resolves #20676

`learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` gains `## Exporting and Reading Cell Values`, between `## Cell Editing` and `## Performance and Big Data`. It covers `toCsv()` and its options, `exportCsv()` and why the download runs on the main thread, a column's `exportRenderer` next to a `renderer`, and `getCellValues()` with `dataFields`, `records` and the `export`/`raw` modes. Every statement was checked against the JSDoc and code in `src/grid/Container.mjs`, `src/grid/column/Base.mjs` and `src/main/addon/FileDownload.mjs`, and against `test/playwright/unit/grid/ToCsv.spec.mjs` and `CellValues.spec.mjs`.

Evidence: L1 (docs-only change; no runtime behavior changes) → L1 required (all five ACs are checkable in the diff and by `npm run check-relative-links`). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The new `##` heading sits directly after `## Cell Editing`'s last subsection (`### Accessibility`) and directly before `## Performance and Big Data`. |
| AC-2 | One `javascript readonly` sample per topic: `toCsv({delimiter, escapeFormulas, header})`, `exportCsv({fileName, ...})`, `exportRenderer({record, value})` with a `renderer`, `getCellValues({dataFields, records})` and `dataFields`. The names match the JSDoc. |
| AC-3 | The defaults are stated as `delimiter` `','`, `escapeFormulas` `true` and `header` `true` in the `toCsv()` options table, `fileName` `'export.csv'` in the `exportCsv()` text, and `mode` `'export'` in the `getCellValues()` options and modes tables. |
| AC-4 | `npm run check-relative-links`: `OK — 395 link(s) resolved across 182 file(s)`. |
| AC-5 | `git diff --stat`: 1 file, 122 insertions, 0 deletions. No existing line changed. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The section also covers two details from the code that the JSDoc does not spell out: the header falls back to the `dataField` when a column has no header text, and the last CSV line has no trailing CRLF (`lines.join('\r\n')`).

## Test Evidence
- `npm run check-relative-links` exits 0, and `git diff --check` is clean.
- Grep of the new section: no ticket or PR ids, and no "framework". Code fences are balanced, and all of them are `javascript readonly`.
- The grid unit specs were not rerun locally, because the unit preflight refused a `node_modules` that is out of sync with `package-lock.json`. The PR changes no code, so CI's unit run covers them as before.
